build_ResLayer_ResNet_backbone: build a ResLayer with BasicBlock to create a ResNet style backbone layer with batch normalization
build_ResLayer_Hourglass: build a ResLayer with downsample_first=False to create an HourglassModule style residual layer
build_ResLayer_avg_downsample: build a ResLayer with avg_down=True to use AvgPool instead of stride conv for downsampling
create_SimplifiedBasicBlock: create a SimplifiedBasicBlock residual block with optional normalization for SCNet architecture
test_SimplifiedBasicBlock_forward: test the SimplifiedBasicBlock forward pass with a sample tensor input and verify output shape
